source: NSSF, Notice to Employers, Year 4 (2026) NSSF Contribution Rates, read 2026-11-05 as a copy hosted on gaa.go.ke (https://gaa.go.ke/sites/default/files/2026-02/Notice%20To%20Employers%20%E2%80%94%20Year%204%20%282026%29%20NSSF%20Contribution%20Rates%20.pdf), signed by the NSSF Managing Trustee/CEO: from February 2026 lower earnings limit 9,000 (6% = 540), upper earnings limit 108,000 (6% of the upper limit less the lower = 5,940), maximum 6,480 per employee and per employer. The employer matches this; it is not a separate pack. The original on nssf.or.ke was not opened.
